name: dream
description: Tools for delivering great code, keeping the codebase coherent, and doing both with minimal user input.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver great code and keep the codebase coherent.
interface.longDescription: Skills for coding that holds a codebase together. One interviews you to turn a rough idea into a brief. One explores the code behind a task with you, and leaves you a reading guide to that code. Others work on their own: they read the code you have, draw out the requirements, design a change, and plan it.
defaultPrompt: Turn my idea into a requirements brief.
Explore the code behind this task with me.
Design a change for this issue, and plan it.
